title: How 5,000 Sailors Eat, Shower & Sleep on an Aircraft Carrier
intro: More than 5,000 people, one ship, jets landing on the roof all night. Here's how sailors eat, shower and sleep on a US Navy aircraft carrier.
asof_line: Figures come from US Navy and DoD reports, 2006–2025.
